tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_profile
tools.description: The Pipeline CRM user this credential acts as: id, name and whether they are an account admin. The user's api_key is never returned. GET /profile.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Pipeline CRM account (id, name, email, team, admin flag). Use the ids as owners of deals, people and companies. api_key values are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_user
tools.description: One user of the account by id. The user's api_key is never returned. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deals
tools.description: List or search deals with stage, owner, company, primary contact, value, probability and expected close date. Filter by name, stage, pipeline, status, owner, company, contact, archived flag, value range and created, expected-close, closed or modified dates. Money values come back as decimal strings.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_deal
tools.description: One deal by id with owner, company, people, stage, status, loss/won reasons, tags, custom fields and the next task. GET /deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_deal_totals_by_stage
tools.description: Count and total value of the deals visible to the user in every deal stage: the pipeline summary. GET /deals/totals_by_stage.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_notes
tools.description: List the notes (activities) logged on one deal, with author, category and content. GET /deals/{id}/notes.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. Give the owner (user id), stage id, value, expected close date and company or primary contact when known; a new company is created from company_name if no company_id is given. No email is sent to the owner. POST /deals.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a deal; only the fields you pass change. Move it to another stage with stage_id. Setting probability to 100 or 0 closes the deal as won or lost; give won/loss reason ids when you do. Archive with archived: true. No email is sent to a new owner. PUT /deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_people
tools.description: List or search people (leads and contacts) with email, phones, position, company, owner, lead status and tags. Use search for a quick match on name, email or company name, or filter precisely. GET /people.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_person
tools.description: One person (lead or contact) by id with all contact details, company, owner, tags and custom fields. GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_person_deals
tools.description: List the deals one person is associated with. GET /people/{id}/deals.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_person_notes
tools.description: List the notes (activities) logged on one person. GET /people/{id}/notes.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: create a lead or contact. Pass at least a first or last name or an email. No email is sent to the owner. POST /people.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_person
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a person; only the fields you pass change. Pass type Contact to convert a lead. PUT /people/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_companies
tools.description: List or search companies with address, website, phones, owner, tags and pipeline totals. GET /companies.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_company
tools.description: One company by id with address, phones, website, owner, tags and custom fields. GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_company_people
tools.description: List the people (leads and contacts) who work at one company. GET /companies/{id}/people.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. POST /companies.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a company; only the fields you pass change. PUT /companies/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_notes
tools.description: List notes (called activities in the Pipeline CRM app) attached to a deal, person or company. Pass at least one of deal_id, person_id, company_id. Filter by text, category, author and created date. GET /notes.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_note
tools.description: One note (activity) by id with its content, author, category, associations and comments. GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: log a note (activity) on a deal, person or company. Pass at least one of deal_id, person_id, company_id. POST /notes.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_calendar_entries
tools.description: List calendar entries: tasks (a due date) and events (a start and end time) tied to deals, people or companies. Filter by kind, owner, a date range, and completed, incomplete or late. GET /calendar_entries.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_get_calendar_entry
tools.description: One calendar entry (task or event) by id. GET /calendar_entries/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_create_calendar_entry
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (CalendarTask, optional due date) or an event (CalendarEvent, start_time and end_time required), optionally tied to a deal, person or company. POST /calendar_entries.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_update_calendar_entry
tools.description: WRITE: change a task or event; only the fields you pass change. Pass complete: true to mark a task done. PUT /calendar_entries/{id}.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_stages
tools.description: List the deal stages with id, name, default win probability and the pipeline each belongs to. Use the ids to filter or move deals. GET /admin/deal_stages.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_deal_pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines (each has its own stages) with id, name and which one is the default. GET /admin/deal_pipelines.

tools.name: pipelinecrm_list_lookup
tools.description: List one set of account lookup values to get ids for filters and writes. kind: deal_statuses, deal_loss_reasons, deal_won_reasons, deal_tags, lead_statuses, lead_sources, contact_tags, company_tags, note_categories, event_categories, task_priorities, task_statuses, teams. GET /admin/<kind>.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pipelinecrm_list_users, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_get_note · Private data: pipelinecrm_get_profile, pipelinecrm_list_deals, pipelinecrm_create_deal, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_get_person, pipelinecrm_create_person, pipelinecrm_update_person, pipelinecrm_list_company_people · Public sink: pipelinecrm_list_users, pipelinecrm_create_deal, pipelinecrm_update_deal, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_create_person, pipelinecrm_create_company, pipelinecrm_add_note, pipelinecrm_create_calendar_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pipelinecrm_list_users, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_get_note · Private data: pipelinecrm_get_profile, pipelinecrm_list_deals, pipelinecrm_create_deal, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_get_person, pipelinecrm_create_person, pipelinecrm_update_person, pipelinecrm_list_company_people · Public sink: pipelinecrm_list_users, pipelinecrm_create_deal, pipelinecrm_update_deal, pipelinecrm_list_people, pipelinecrm_create_person, pipelinecrm_create_company, pipelinecrm_add_note, pipelinecrm_create_calendar_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
